text: Official Oneleet MCP server that connects an AI assistant through a browser login, with a consent review and a choice of workspace
quote: add the Oneleet MCP server to your assistant, and it opens a browser window where you log in to Oneleet, review what the assistant is asking for, and pick the workspace it should work in.

text: An MCP-connected assistant acts as the user, is limited to that user's workspace role, and every action is attributed to the user's account
quote: Once connected, the assistant acts as you. It can only see and do what your own role in the workspace allows, and every action is attributed to your account.

text: Service keys for agents, MCP servers and scripts that are decoupled from user accounts and can be scoped to specific tasks
quote: Use **service keys** for AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts to interact with your Oneleet workspace. Service keys are decoupled from user accounts and can be scoped for specific tasks.

text: Service keys can be granted full access to all tenant scopes or limited to only specific scopes
quote: Grant Full access to all tenant service-key scopes, or choose Limit access to… to grant only specific scopes.

text: Code scanning results become findings that can be triaged, assigned and resolved on the platform
quote: The results become findings you can triage, assign, and resolve on the platform, with a CI check that keeps new issues out of your pull requests.

text: A CI check keeps new code security issues out of pull requests
quote: with a CI check that keeps new issues out of your pull requests

text: Repositories' target branches are scanned daily, and scans can also be started manually at any time
quote: Oneleet scans the target branch of each repository once a day, and you can start a scan manually at any time with New scan.

text: DAST-based application security testing evaluates running web apps from the outside in by crawling them and exercising their inputs and forms
quote: Oneleet Application Security uses Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) to evaluate your running web applications by testing them from the outside in, much like an attacker would.

text: Application security testing logs in first so it can test the authenticated attack surface
quote: When an application requires a login, Oneleet Application Security authenticates first, so it tests the authenticated attack surface of the application

text: Monitors AWS accounts, RDS instances, Application and Classic load balancers, and IAM users
quote: Oneleet currently monitors the following AWS resources: Accounts, RDS instances, Application and Classic load balancers, IAM users

text: AWS access works through AssumeRole and can be revoked by deleting the created role
quote: Oneleet uses the AWS AssumeRole API to work with AWS resources — if you'd like to remove Oneleet's access to your workspace, simply delete the created role

text: GitHub integration monitors configuration, user access and Dependabot vulnerabilities without needing access to repository contents
quote: This integration supports Cloud Security monitoring for GitHub. You can use it to monitor your GitHub configuration, user access, and Dependabot vulnerabilities. It does not require access to repository contents.

text: Monitors Google Workspace user accounts and Gmail settings
quote: Oneleet currently monitors the following on Google Workspace: User accounts, GMail settings

text: RBAC with custom organization roles that have precisely chosen permissions and can be assigned to members
quote: with RBAC you can also create your own organization roles with a precise set of permissions and assign them to members.

text: Built-in MDM lets admins verify devices are managed, view security posture, enforce settings, and take remote action on lost or offboarded devices
quote: Admins can confirm that devices are managed, see each device’s security posture, enforce security settings, and take remote action when a device is lost, stolen, or being offboarded.

text: Company-owned devices are managed from the same dashboard as the rest of the security and compliance program
quote: Oneleet MDM lets your team manage company-owned devices from the same dashboard as the rest of your security and compliance program.

text: One-click recommended secure baseline for macOS and Windows that pre-fills an editable organization-wide device policy
quote: Oneleet offers a recommended secure baseline for macOS and Windows that can be applied in one click. Applying the secure defaults pre-fills settings as your organization-wide device policy - nothing is locked in.

text: Macs enroll through Apple MDM, either manually or zero-touch via Automated Device Enrollment
quote: Macs enroll through Apple's Mobile Device Management framework, either manually or zero-touch through Automated Device Enrollment

text: Policy template library offered in two types: Formal (minimum viable) and Comprehensive
quote: Our platform offers two types of policy templates to assist you in this process: Formal (Minimum Viable Policies)... Comprehensive

text: Policy templates can be customized to reflect the organization's own practices
quote: When customizing the templates, focus on adjusting the language to reflect your organization’s practices without altering the core intent of the policies.

text: Draft policies that don't require review can be published together from the Policies page
quote: On the **Policies** page, choose **Publish draft policies** to publish drafts that don’t require review.

text: A human-led penetration test is included and feeds directly into the audit
quote: Drata makes you hire a pentest firm for $5k to $15k. Oneleet includes a human-led one, straight into your audit.

text: Includes engineers who fix pentest findings and a dedicated vCISO
quote: Oneleet gives you the actual security: a real pentest, engineers who fix what it finds, and a vCISO.

text: Pentests, code scanning, device management and vCISO are bundled at one flat fee, with no per-framework or implementation costs
quote: Human pentests, code scanning, device management, and a dedicated vCISO. One platform, one flat fee.

text: Removing a framework removes its unused auto-added controls but keeps controls shared with other frameworks or that contain work
quote: Removing a framework also removes unused controls that were automatically added for it. Controls stay when another framework requires them or when they contain work such as evidence, review history, assignments, or custom content.

text: Fieldwork AI agents collect, validate and package control evidence across enterprise systems on a schedule
quote: Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.

text: Customizable, publishable Trust Center that can be linked from the company's landing page
quote: set up and publish your customizable Trust Center. You can add a link to the Trust Center on your Landing Page to show your ongoing commitment to security.

text: Supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR and other frameworks in one platform
quote: Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework. Oneleet's all-in-one platform simplifies your compliance journey.
